target.title: fix(admin-http-rpc): reject oversized declared request bodies
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Admin HTTP RPC callers could declare an oversized JSON request body with `Content-Length` above the 1 MiB limit and have the shared request reader tear down the socket before the route could deliver the structured 413 response.

## Why This Change Was Made

The Admin HTTP RPC handler now rejects well-formed oversized declared `Content-Length` values at the plugin route boundary before entering the shared body reader. The existing shared reader still handles missing, invalid, chunked, timeout, closed-connection, and malformed-JSON cases, so this stays local to the Admin HTTP RPC route and does not change the RPC allowlist, Gateway authentication, or method dispatch behavior.

## User Impact

Operators and host tooling using `POST /api/v1/admin/rpc` get a clear HTTP 413 JSON response for oversized declared request bodies, and invalid oversized requests do not reach Gateway RPC dispatch.

## Evidence

- Claim proved: Admin HTTP RPC now delivers a structured 413 response to a real Node HTTP client for `Content-Length: 1048577`, and `dispatchGatewayMethod` is not called.
- Current head: f6b47788b1710b842f4a72cc18639a4f9193d57c.
- Focused regression: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/admin-http-rpc/src/handler.test.ts` passed with 1 file and 13 tests.
- Sibling guard regression: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/infra/http-body.test.ts` passed with 1 file and 13 tests.
- Targeted format: `node_modules\.bin\oxfmt.CMD --check --threads=1 extensions\admin-http-rpc\src\handler.ts extensions\admin-http-rpc\src\handler.test.ts` passed.
- Committed diff hygiene: `git diff --check HEAD~1..HEAD` passed.
- Review proof: `python .agents\skills\autoreview\scripts\autoreview --mode commit --commit HEAD --engine claude` passed with no accepted/actionable findings.
- Observed result: the real HTTP regression starts a Node `createServer`, sends a Node HTTP client request declaring `Content-Length: 1048577`, receives HTTP 413 with `{ "ok": false, "error": { "type": "invalid_request", "message": "Payload too large" } }`, and verifies the Gateway dispatcher was not called.

AI-assisted: yes. I reviewed the Admin HTTP RPC route boundary, shared SDK body guard behavior, focused tests, and ClawSweeper feedback before updating this PR.
